title: Treesa and Gayatri's World Championships Giant-Killing Spree Ends in Semifinals
indian_angle: The unseeded Indian women's doubles pair secured a historic bronze medal at the BWF World Championships.
summary: Top seeds and defending champions Sheng and Ning defeated the unseeded Indian pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand in three games in the World Championships semifinals, ending their impressive run with a bronze medal.

title: Gopichand: No Extra Emotion for Daughter Gayatri's Worlds Medal, All Players Equal
indian_angle: Indian coach Pullela Gopichand shares his perspective on his daughter Gayatri's significant achievement at the World Championships.
summary: Coach Pullela Gopichand stated that while proud, he feels no extra emotion for his daughter Gayatri's World Championships medal, treating all players under his guidance equally after her semifinal defeat with Treesa Jolly.

title: Post-Worlds, Gopichand Shifts Focus to Asian Games Preparations
indian_angle: Indian coach Pullela Gopichand outlines his strategy for preparing the national badminton squad for the upcoming Asian Games.
summary: Following the BWF World Championships, coach Pullela Gopichand is now concentrating on focused training for the Asian Games, aiming to build on the bronze medal success of Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly.

title: Treesa-Gayatri Bronze Ends 15-Year Drought, Echoes Jwala-Ashwini 2011 Medal
indian_angle: This article highlights the historical significance of Treesa and Gayatri's medal, connecting it to India's past achievements in women's doubles.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's bronze medal at the BWF World Championships marks a significant milestone, ending a 15-year drought for Indian women's doubles and drawing parallels to the Jwala Gutta and Ashwini Ponnappa medal in 2011.

title: Satwik-Chirag Exit World Championships in Quarterfinals After Loss to Chinese Pair
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair faced a tough challenge and exited the World Championships in the quarter-final stage.
summary: India's premier men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, were defeated by China's Chang and Liang in the BWF World Championships quarter-finals with a score of 21-18, 21-9.
